headline: Micron HBM verification architect role assigns GenAI methods and pre-silicon AI debug
fact: Micron advertised HBM Staff Design Verification Engineer/Architect role JR94769 in Richardson. It assigns GenAI verification-methodology development aligned with HBM design cycles and AI-assisted root-cause analysis of pre-silicon as well as post-silicon issues. The role accepts digital, FastSPICE analog or mixed-signal co-simulation/real-number-modeling experience and spans IP/SoC verification architecture. Its scope is broader than dedicated AMS verification; it does not assign every GenAI task to RNM. A retained July listing predates the current September Workday date.

sources.summary: Official full Workday response gives startDate September 15, 2026 and explicit GenAI methodology, pre/post-silicon AI debug and analog/AMS/RNM experience. This current date is later than retained recruiting history, not a verified first publication.
